bullets.content: [general] Change exactly one factor per solve (solve 1 base, solve 2 base + one change, compare(1,2), then decide). Mixed changes gave unattributable 13-20% differences repeatedly. Keep h fixed when testing refinements. No coarser mesh without reason.

[general] After every solve read the top-5 hotspots (location, nearest face, local h) and view(kind=error). Place the next refinement at those coordinates, sized about half the reported local h; use compare() to locate the error region before placing a tight box.

[general] REPEATED: you promise a DOF cap, then solve above it (21k, 23.4k). After each mesh, if nodes exceed cap (e.g. 5000 nodes ≈ 15k DOFs), re-mesh (free) before solving. Tick the cap off explicitly before each solve.

[general] Promise list before each mesh(): (1) DOFs <=16k else raise h 10% and re-mesh; (2) quality.min >=0.12 else widen r to >=0.008; (3) each refined group's touching h <=1.3x request; (4) one change vs last solve.

[general] After solve 1 call view(kind=error, iso) before placing any box. Read hotspot local h and touching-h of groups named in hotspots. If hotspot h exceeds 1.4x request, re-mesh with a box over the band, not a smaller edge size.

[general] Never call compare(solve_a = solve_b): the 0.3% diff and its 'region' are noise and misled an agent into refining f22. Compare previous vs new solve and read regions[0..2] before the next mesh.
[general] Use all 4 solves. If compare() of your two best solves still differs by more than 5% in energy norm, spend the last solve on a hotspot-targeted variant and compare again before submitting.

[general] If nodes DROP after adding a refinement or min quality falls below 0.12, the size field misbehaved. Non-monotonic node counts occur; verify nodes and quality before solving, keep r>=0.005; re-mesh with box or wider radius.
[general] Cost matters: 27.7k DOFs vs 6k for the automesher gave only 1.98x gain. Before the final solve check whether a coarser mesh scores better; the gain is divided by the DOF ratio.
[general] Quote only numbers returned by tools in this run; do not reason from remembered numbers of earlier runs (e.g. 0.0338 J), they corrupted a convergence estimate.

[general] Before every solve compute break-even: below target, score=(target_err/e)²/(DOFs/automesher DOFs). For abc_00000003_bc7: (0.1593/e)²/(DOFs/6057); 12k DOFs needs e<26%, 15k needs e<23% to beat 0.189. Re-mesh if DOFs exceed what expected e can pay.
[general] Realised size ≈1.4-1.6x request on small groups (f16 0.0028→0.00455, f19 0.0032→0.0045). Request 0.7x target; re-mesh until touching-h table is within 1.2x of target before solving.

[general] After every mesh read the touching-h table. Touching h comes out about 1.3-1.4x the request (f2 0.0024->0.00341, f16 0.003->0.00395). If a refined group exceeds 1.2x the request, re-mesh with group/box or wider radius. Keep radius at or below the band width; radii 0.005-0.007 on a 34 mm part pulled median h to 0.00395.

[general] With h 0.03, an edge refinement 0.0018 r 0.006 ramps to >0.006 one mm away, so it can't cover a 1-3 mm stress band. Cover bands with a box at target size; use edges only for the singular line.
[general] Quality: in h 0.03 a 0.0036 box r 0.008 gave 0.0603; 0.0038 r 0.012 gave 0.110. Keep a buffer box >=0.0042 with r>=0.012 around finer strips. If quality <0.12 widen r to 0.015.

[general] Scoring arithmetic: near target score ~1/(e^2*N) below it, ~1/(e*N) above. With 3D order-2, e~N^-2/3, so uniform refinement gains little. Reach about the target error at minimum DOFs by refining only where hotspot local h is at or above median.
[general] When equal-DOF meshes differ 15-18% in compare, true error is about that size. Strain-energy differences under 0.5% cannot pick a submission; use hotspot local h in the binding bands.

[general] compare between similar-density meshes is an error indicator, not noise (16.8% for 25.3k vs 24.4k; true 18.1%, solver est 15.5%). Last compare diff (19.2k→21.1k gave 10.5%) estimates the coarser mesh error, about equal to the finer if hotspot h changed little. Use the larger estimate.

[general] For thin-walled tubes compute wall thickness from inspect_geometry (radii or annulus area). Use at least 2 order-2 elements through the wall in hot regions. Error is often at the INNER surface near clamps and bore intersections, not outer re-entrant edges.

[general] Clamped faces meeting loaded or free walls create near-singular edges. Error energy concentrates within about 1-2 mm of the clamp line; refine edges or thin strips there at about 0.4x median h, not whole faces or full-thickness boxes.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Group refinements on f20 (3199 elements) plus f23 (2452) at 0.0036/0.004 made almost the whole mesh: 23.4k DOFs, 18.6%, base 0.189 < automesher 0.25. Never refine f23 below 0.0045; whole-group f20/f23 is wasteful. Put DOFs on edge 40 and edges 8/39.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp band z 0.052-0.06 near f20/edge 40 holds 19.4% of error at mean h 0.0041 (hotspots #1/#2/#6, vM ~30%). Use {edge:40,size:0.002,r:0.007}; target touching f2/f20 ≤0.0032. Expect share to roughly halve.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Teacher's next call: mesh(h=0.016,order=2,refinements=[{edge:40,size:0.002,radius:0.007},{edge:8,size:0.0022,radius:0.007},{edge:39,size:0.0022,radius:0.007},{group:f16,size:0.0022,radius:0.006},{group:f19,size:0.0026,radius:0.006},{group:f20,size:0.0045,radius:0.004}])

[abc_00000003_bc7] Boxes spanning boss junctions fail quality: x ±0.021 junction box 0.0036 r0.007 gave 0.066; wall box 0.0042 r0.008 at h 0.0095 gave 0.076. Clamp-only ring box [-0.0185,-0.0185,0.052,0.0185,0.0185,0.0605] 0.0032 r0.006 gave 0.2175. Refine rims by edges/groups, not boxes.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Probe free DOF floor first: mesh(h=0.016,refinements=[]) and h=0.02. Log nodes, then node delta for each added edge/group to see which refinement eats DOFs.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Keep f16 refined in every recipe (P0 near f16 read +1.5%). Caps f15 (h 0.0089) and f25 (0.0066) carry near-zero error; leave coarse.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Boss face f3 near (0.02,-0.007,0.030) has local h 0.0054 and holds worst hidden check point (10.5%) plus hotspot #3. Try f3 group 0.0035 r0.005 (watch DOFs) or a point refinement there.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Quality: h 0.014 with r 0.005-0.006 and sizes to 0.0025 gave min quality 0.199/0.2175 (safe); h 0.0095 with 0.003 box r0.008 gave 0.076 (invalid). Keep h ~0.014-0.016 with r 0.005-0.007.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Quality: h 0.009 box 0.003 r 0.006 gave 0.0986 (invalid); h 0.012 r 0.005 gave 0.136; r 0.004-0.005 gave 0.20. For 0.0026-0.003 at h 0.0085 use r 0.008 rather than coarsening h.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Global h 0.012 inflates local sizes (f16 0.0032 to 0.00558; boxes to 0.0039-0.0045). Keep h <=0.0085 so requests land within 1.3x. f16-side junction cells (x -0.0174, z 0.0255-0.0357) held ~13.5% of error.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hotspots #1/#2 at x -0.0194, z 0.030 within 1 mm of f16, local h ~0.006, 25% error. A group request alone gave 1.7x. Use junction box [-0.022,-0.012,0.022,-0.012,0.012,0.040] size 0.003 or point (-0.0195,0,0.030) size 0.0025 r 0.008; re-mesh until f16 touching h <=0.0035.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Tube boxes must be continuous in z: z 0.037-0.048 and z <0.004 (hotspot #3 at z 0.002) were uncovered. Use z 0.018-0.048 and z -0.001-0.018 (size 0.0036-0.004, r 0.008) if DOFs allow. Self: bottom box z 0.004-0.018 and f3 0.004 found no hotspot; weigh against coverage.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp band: error is on bore f20 at z~0.055, 5 mm below f2, not on f2. f2 group 0.0024 landed only 0.00341. Use ring box [-0.018,-0.018,0.048,0.018,0.018,0.061] size 0.003 r 0.006; drop separate edge-40 refinement (quality fell to 0.112).

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction hotspots are on the TUBE WALL (f20 side), |x| 0.009-0.012, |y| 0.011-0.013, z 0.025-0.030, local h 0.0036-0.0038. Use tube-only box [-0.018,-0.018,0.018,0.018,0.018,0.037] size 0.0035 r 0.006; do not cover bosses at |x|>0.018. Self alt: z 0.022-0.032 size 0.0025.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Plan: 1) h 0.016 edge-only recipe (edges 40/8/39 + f16/f19), ≤15k DOFs; 2) same + f20 0.0038 r0.004, compare(1,2); 3) better at h 0.02, compare; 4) best plus hotspot fix. Submit by estimated score, not DOFs alone. Don't start at 23k.

[abc_00000003_bc7] compare diffs between near-equal meshes under-read: 26k vs 23.4k gave 14.3% while true error was 18.6%. Treat diff >14% as 'target missed'; only a diff to a mesh ≥1.3x finer in hotspot regions approximates coarse error.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Check-point term (13.3%) is set by P1 (-43%, low-stress 4.2 MPa point at (-0.0077,0.0064,0.0574) on f23 top face by the clamp). Edge-40 refinement should fix P1 and the 19% field share; optionally point refinement 0.003 r0.006 at P1. Judge by field first.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16; strain energy 0.0328-0.0334 J across 22-27k DOFs. Spend no solves on setup.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Avoid boxes to z +0.0081: the 0.0038 box (z -0.006..0.0081) cost ~860 nodes (~2.6k DOFs) and pulled quality to 0.1103 while upper wall stayed dark. Cap buffer at z 0.004, size 0.0045 r 0.012. Avoid full-thickness boxes (17k DOFs earlier).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspot #6 (3.3%, f38 side, y ~0.020, z -0.0045) sat at h 0.00625 outside box y<=0.014. Extend strip/buffer to y 0.022-0.024; expect under 2% for ~200 nodes.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] DOF floor is 4808 nodes (14.4k DOFs) at h 0.03 from curved faces. Each 1000 extra nodes costs c +0.34. Budget at most 1800 nodes of refinement (<=6600 nodes, ~19.8k DOFs), mostly in the clamp-root strip.
